definition.name: Raise All Site Elevations
definition.description: Raises the elevation of every project site by a given amount in mm, keeping E/N and angles (handles mirrored sites), rolling back if anything else changes.
definition.aiDescription: Raises the elevation of every project site by a given amount in mm, keeping E/N and angles (handles mirrored sites), rolling back if anything else changes.
examples: increase the elevation of both sites by 300 mm
